items.briefing:
Two issues stand out for Australian organisations today. First, AI-related data breaches are increasing sharply, with staff feeding sensitive information into AI tools that then leak it "downstream" to unintended parties. A separate survey found that while most ANZ small businesses are adopting AI quickly, many don't fully trust or understand it — a combination that raises real risk. Second, a local ANZ survey found that more than half of organisations have experienced a print security incident, a reminder that physical devices remain a genuine vulnerability.

**Practical tip:** Check what information staff are entering into AI tools — remind them to treat AI chatbots like a public forum and never paste in confidential client or organisational data.

featured.title: Print security incidents hit over half in ANZ survey
featured.quote: Over half of ANZ organisations face print security incidents, a widespread vulnerability many overlook.
